messages:
anika: heads up — bringing up reranker-v2-int8 on the rerank holdout. quick stats: MRR +0.9% but NDCG@10 -1.8% on the anchor-heavy slice. s3://redwood-evals/rerank/2026/anchor_holdout.json :confused:

matt: which slice definition exactly? anchor-heavy = queries with explicit product tokens, or something else?

anika: anchor-heavy = queries with >1 anchor phrase (brand/product tokens), sample size ~3k, seed=42. quant config: PTQ symmetric, we removed L2 normalization on embedding outputs for perf (that may be relevant).

cheng: removing L2 normalization can flip cosine rankings after quant. quick check: run eval with post-quant L2 applied and compare. try this command:

```bash
python infra/eval.py \
  --model rerank-v2-int8 \
  --holdout s3://redwood-evals/rerank/2026/anchor_holdout.json \
  --batch 256 \
  --seed 42 \
  --apply-embed-norm l2
```

eval-bot: quick-run finished (15m):
- with L2: NDCG@10 = 0.724 (+1.9% vs no-l2 baseline), MRR@10 = 0.512 (+1.1%)
- without L2: NDCG@10 = 0.702 (-1.8% vs with-l2), MRR@10 = 0.519 (+0.9%)
notes: long-document queries show larger NDCG deltas.

matt: :eyes: interesting — MRR number goes up slightly w/o L2 but ndcg drops, suggests top-k ordering vs global ranking change.

sara: i'll run parity tests: pairwise vs listwise harness + a paraphrase-augmented anchor set (1k paraphrases) to see robustness. ETA ~2h.

anika: also want to try a tiny calibration set (1k paraphrase anchors) to tune output scaling; hypothesis: L2 + calibration can recover NDCG without losing MRR.

cheng: also add embed scaling probe (multiply by 1/||v|| vs dividing) and seed determinism (10 runs) to checklist. could be that quant noise interacts with scaling.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: rerank-v2-int8-l2 canary -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-20T14:12:00Z

anika: action items:
- sara: run pairwise/listwise + paraphrase aug and report slice-level NDCG/MRR (in 2h)
- matt: run seed determinism (10 seeds) and post variance numbers
- cheng: validate embed scaling variants and whether to keep post-quant L2 in the serving path
- anika: open PR with eval config and summary of runs
:white_check_mark:

sara: on it.
